name: XYZI+CUBE Format
definition: An optional optimised version of the normal vox format which uses less disk space by saving chunks of voxels with the same property (specifically cubes) instead of every voxel individually.
summary: XYZI+CUBE is an optimized voxel format that reduces disk space by grouping contiguous same-color voxels into maximal axis-aligned cubes using a greedy expansion algorithm.
